titles.romaji: Zoku Tsuma Netori: Ikumi to Shizuka
titles.native: 続・妻ネトリ 郁美と静香

description:
Distrustful of the changes she has noticed in Ikumi, Shizuka begins to investigate on her own, but is caught and restrained by Tanba! Trembling in fear at her impending confinement and humiliation, Shizuka looks on worryingly at the deranged man, who slowly approaches his untainted prey, drooling in anticipation. Thus begins a prolonged banquet of shame and disgrace.

(Source: Coolmic)
